# ascii.rest

All 240 animation modules and the canvas player from https://github.com/bas3line/ascii
(ascii.rest 0.4.0). Downloaded from https://ascii.rest/ on 2026-10-21.
All 15 categories are included, with the catalogue in src/shared/terminalBackgroundCatalog.ts.
These files are bundled locally; terminal backgrounds make no network requests.

Catalogue thumbnails are pre-rendered WebP files in src/renderer/src/assets/ascii-posters.
They avoid running scene generators during scrolling. Regenerate them with
`node scripts/generate-ascii-posters.mjs` when sharp is available as a build tool,
or pass its module entrypoint as the script's first argument. It is not required
to build or run CanvasTTY from the checked-in posters.

Animated catalogue previews are pre-rendered WebP clips in assets/ascii-animations,
generated by the same SVG rasterizer as their posters. Add --animated to the
generator command to rebuild them. The catalogue uses one image element and no
live canvas rendering; terminal backgrounds use the upstream player.
